rows.label: bf06180100_0005
rows.name: With Bahn's intervention causing all that confusion...

rows.label: bf06180100_0010
rows.name:
it almost feels like we got talked into
exactly what they wanted.

rows.label: bf06180100_0020
rows.name:
Blade supply is entirely at the Holy See's discretion.
It's frustrating.

rows.label: bf06180100_0030
rows.name:
Awakening rates from natural
cores are very low,

rows.label: bf06180100_0040
rows.name:
which limits the pool
of compatible Drivers.

rows.label: bf06180100_0050
rows.name:
So baptism at the Holy See is necessary
to distribute them widely?

rows.label: bf06180100_0060
rows.name: That much I am willing to accept.

rows.label: bf06180100_0070
rows.name:
The real problem is the fact that
Heaven's Holy Grail has awakened.

rows.label: bf06180100_0080
rows.name:
This is no time to be
squabbling over territory.

rows.label: bf06180100_0090
rows.name:
If we misread the situation or respond badly,
Invidia will sink to the bottom of the Cloud Sea.

rows.label: bf06180100_0110
rows.name:
has Meleph, his close retainer, traveling
with Heaven's Holy Grail and the others.

rows.label: bf06180100_0120
rows.name:
And now we find ourselves
in their debt...

rows.label: bf06180100_0130
rows.name: I never expected him to take action like that...

rows.label: bf06180100_0140
rows.name:
Was it just the passion
of youth, or was it...?

rows.label: bf06180100_0160
rows.name:
In any case, for now we should keep our troops
mobilized while we monitor the situation.

rows.label: bf06180100_0170
rows.name:
I hardly expect Luxuria will
comply so easily, either.
